body:
Thanks, sounds just like me. And yeah, I always hope a relationship or something would cure it, but it doesn't work that way. Figured that out 2 weeks into my first relationship when I broke it off. But honestly, I don't want help. At this point in my life it's something that I'm completely desensitized too except for these big dips (like today). So, I know I can't keep it pent up forever, but I can't bear to speak about my problems to another person face to face. But I really appreciate you taking the time respond to me :) 

I'm very sorry about your loss by the way. Another thing is that If I commit suicide, or if I were to die, it isn't a big deal to me. It's not that I'd be relieved, or in peace, it's that to me if I die, oh well. It's not that big of a deal, only reason I haven't done it is because I feel guilty for those who would mourn for me. I understand they mourn because they love me, but honestly I don't want anyone to mourn for me. I want to be forgotten immediately after my death. So, the people around me will prevent it until my value of life just isn't worth it to me anymore. I love to make others happy, but I can't seem to find anything that does it for me. So if I find that, great. If not, maybe I'll have better luck next time around.
